source_notes: Compiled 2026-10-01 from web search results restricted to longforte.com (www.longforte.com and shop.app are blocked here; WebFetch returned EGRESS_BLOCKED). Facts are taken only from search-result titles/snippets. Prices labelled 'wholesale_seen' are from snippets, which display a '$' symbol; Longforte is a UK site so these are most likely GBP and may be ex or inc VAT - verify in the trade account before costing. RRPs are estimates only (roughly 2.5-4x wholesale where a price was seen, otherwise set against similar personalised gifts). Also researched but held back to keep the first launch to about 70 products: rock matt and panoramic slates, 16x20in and matt metal prints, crystal glass frame, digital alarm clock, glass door sign, placemat gift set, glow-in-the-dark bottle, 20oz skinny tumbler, 15oz and gold-handle mugs, baby t-shirt, cat-lid bottle, golf towel, linen and burlap cushions, bookmarks, ceramic ornaments, and the 11x14in and A5 jigsaws (all are in facts). Excluded: standard 11oz white mugs, bath towels, baby grows, santa sacks, mouse mats (Foxy already sells), phone cases (model churn, see facts), snowglobe bottles (UV DTF/vinyl, not sublimation), lanyards (B2B rather than gifting). Every product must still follow CLAUDE.md: DRAFT status, product-facts.md sheet per family (most of these families need new sheets; anything marked ASK must be asked).
